description: This source file contains unit tests for the GatewayProcessManager component in the OpenClaw project, utilizing Swift's testing frameworks. It includes tests for gateway health checks, connection management, and process attachment logic.

classes.name: GatewayProcessManagerTests
classes.description: A suite of asynchronous unit tests for GatewayProcessManager, focusing on health checks, connection attachment, and failure state handling.

methods.name: `clears last failure when health succeeds`
methods.description: Tests that the GatewayProcessManager clears its last failure reason upon successful health check.

methods.name: `attaches to existing gateway without spawning launchd`
methods.description: Verifies that the GatewayProcessManager can attach to an existing gateway process without spawning a new one, and correctly updates its status and details.
